9kcLAdugkK5hvDJECYo3pw.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,6/25新增48例確定病例,其中11例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(42例)及北基伍省(6例)。迄6/25累計1,203例確定病例(321例死亡、148例康復),致死率26.7%,疫情主要集中在東部伊圖里(1,096例)、北基伍(104例) 及南基伍省(3例)共34個衛生區,接觸者追蹤率約82.8%。 烏干達自6/21新增1例確定病例後,迄無新增疫情,迄6/27累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、15例康復),其中15例為境外移入、5 例為本土病例。個案分布於首都坎帕拉(Kampala)及瓦基索區(Wakiso),均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關,尚無社區傳播疫情。 WHO非洲區署依據DRC截至6/8的累計598例確定病例數作SEIRD隨機數理模型推估,預測DRC至9/16將達8,210例確定病例(其中1,440例死亡)。推估截至8/12對烏干達造成至少1例境外移入的可能性為94.2%,其次為南蘇丹(可能性69.3%)、盧安達(可能性8.6%)、蒲隆地(可能性2%)。
9kcLAdugkK5hvDJECYo3pw.en: The DRC continues to report new cases. On 25 June, 48 new confirmed cases were added, including 11 deaths, in Ituri Province (42 cases) and North Kivu Province (6). As of 25 June, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,203 (321 deaths, 148 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 26.7%. The outbreak is mainly concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri (1,096 cases), North Kivu (104) and South Kivu (3), across 34 health zones. The contact tracing rate is about 82.8%. Uganda has reported no new cases since adding one on 21 June. As of 27 June, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 15 recoveries), of which 15 were imported and 5 were local cases. The cases are in the capital, Kampala, and Wakiso District, all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure, and there is no community transmission. The WHO Regional Office for Africa, using a SEIRD stochastic model based on the DRC's cumulative total of 598 confirmed cases as of 8 June, projects that the DRC will reach 8,210 confirmed cases by 16 September, including 1,440 deaths. The model estimates a 94.2% probability that Uganda will have at least one imported case by 12 August, followed by South Sudan (69.3%), Rwanda (8.6%) and Burundi (2%).

KJ-_goMXOr-aSFysbuFOZA.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,6/15新增29例確定病例,其中4例死亡,截至6/15累計報告837例確定病例(196例死亡、49 例康復),致死率23.4%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共31個衛生區。 烏干達迄至6/16連續8日無新增病例(最後一例為6/8),累計19例確定病例(2例死亡、7例康復)。 ECDC以模型推估實際疫情較報告之疫情嚴峻,其中一個模型估計,截至6/13,累計感染人數是通報病例數之3.0到10.2倍(90%可信區間),另盧安達、坦尚亞和肯亞的輸入風險最高,而歐盟/歐洲經濟區的輸入風險則為低。
KJ-_goMXOr-aSFysbuFOZA.en: The DRC has reported 29 new confirmed cases on 15 June, including 4 deaths. As of 15 June, 837 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (196 deaths, 49 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 23.4%. Cases are mainly concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces, across 31 health zones. Uganda has reported no new cases for 8 consecutive days through 16 June (last case on 8 June), with 19 confirmed cases cumulatively (2 deaths, 7 recoveries). ECDC modelling suggests the actual outbreak is more severe than reported. One model estimates that, as of 13 June, cumulative infections were 3.0 to 10.2 times the number of reported cases (90% credible interval). Rwanda, Tanzania and Kenya face the highest importation risk, while the importation risk for the EU/EEA is low.

QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續擴大,截至5/24累計報告112例確診及11例死亡、906例疑病例及223例疑病例死亡,主要分布於伊圖里省、北基伍省及南基伍省;烏干達迄今累積報告7例確診,其中1例死亡;義大利出現2例疑病例,在烏干達擔任為期三個月的援助工作人員,返回義國後,出現高燒、嘔吐、腹瀉和噁心等疑症狀,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。非洲CDC評估有11個國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、南蘇丹、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、坦尚亞、尚比亞及索馬利亞。
QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to expand: as of 24 May, 112 confirmed cases and 11 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda has reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, one of which was fatal. Italy reported two suspected cases involving an aid worker who had spent three months in Uganda. After returning to Italy, the person developed suspected symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and nausea, but tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases in Italy. The Africa CDC assesses that 11 countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, South Sudan, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Zambia and Somalia.

sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情持續擴大,疫情主要分布於DRC伊圖里與北基伍省,兩國截至5/23累計報告91例確診及10例死亡、867例疑病例及204例疑病例死亡,且匡列1,261名接觸者。DRC伊圖里省傳出3名紅十字會志工染病死亡,南基伍省(South Kivu)亦於5/20通報首例28歲死亡確診個案。烏干達迄今累積報告5例確診,其中1例死亡。另南蘇丹澄清其境內疑病例,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。 WHO指出疫情在5/15通報前恐已隱匿傳播數週或數月,導致疫情蔓延至多個省份。非洲CDC評估有10個非洲國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、南蘇丹、坦尚亞及尚比亞。 WHO緊急委員會第一次會議臨時建議,評估剛果民主共和國風險為「非常高」,烏干達及區域風險為「高」,全球風險為「低」。建議疫區國家啟動國家災害或突發事件管理機制,並執行包括加強監測等防控措施;區域層級國家應建立與地方各層級相銜接的國家協調機制制定相關措施;其他國家對來自已記錄到病毒(BDBV)感染地區出現不明原因發熱症狀的旅行者進行檢測、評估、報告及管理,執行公眾之疫情風險溝通等。
sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.en: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to expand, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu provinces of the DRC. As of 23 May, the two countries had reported 91 confirmed cases and 10 deaths, 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths, and 1,261 contacts had been listed. In Ituri Province, DRC, three Red Cross volunteers were reported to have died after infection. South Kivu Province reported its first confirmed case, a death in a 28-year-old, on 20 May. Uganda has reported five cumulative confirmed cases, one of which was fatal. South Sudan clarified that a suspected case in its territory tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases there. WHO notes that the outbreak may have spread silently for several weeks or months before it was reported on 15 May, leading to spread across multiple provinces. The Africa CDC assesses that 10 African countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Zambia. The first meeting of the WHO Emergency Committee provisionally assessed the risk as very high for the DRC, high for Uganda and at regional level, and low globally. It recommends that affected countries activate national disaster or emergency management mechanisms and implement control measures, including enhanced surveillance; that countries in the region establish national coordination mechanisms linked to local levels; and that other countries test, assess, report and manage travellers with unexplained fever who have been in areas where Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) infection has been recorded, and communicate public health risks.

eGHpbDTn2rNUOvFxD-BJTA.zh: WHO12/20宣布盧安達疫情結束,於最後1例病例檢測陰性後,已經連續42日(2倍潛伏期)未新增報告病例。此波疫情於9/27爆發,截至10/30累計報告66例病例,其中15例死亡(CFR:23%),病患中近7成為男性,且近8成為醫療工作者,分布集中於3行政區;WHO評估,本次疫情來源為果蝠,未來仍可能透過接觸動物或患者體液傳播,目前該國國內/區域/全球風險均為低。
eGHpbDTn2rNUOvFxD-BJTA.en: On 20 December, WHO declared the end of the Rwanda outbreak: 42 consecutive days (twice the incubation period) had passed without any new case reported since the last case tested negative. The outbreak began on 27 September; as of 30 October, 66 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 15 deaths (CFR 23%). Nearly 70% of patients were men, and nearly 80% were healthcare workers, with cases concentrated in three administrative districts. WHO assesses that the source of this outbreak was fruit bats, and that transmission through contact with animals or patients' bodily fluids may still occur in future. The national, regional and global risk for the country is currently assessed as low.

auWmVl4IRec74MZilkCOyA.zh: WHO公布盧安達最後1例病例已於11/8出院,倘未來42日內無發生新病例,則將宣布本次疫情結束。該國自9/27疫情爆發迄今累計確診66例,其中15例死亡(CFR:22.7%),近8成為醫療感染,並未產生社區傳播鏈。
auWmVl4IRec74MZilkCOyA.en: WHO reports that Rwanda's last patient was discharged from hospital on 8 November. If no new cases occur within 42 days, the outbreak will be declared over. Since the outbreak began on 27 September, the country has cumulatively confirmed 66 cases, including 15 deaths (CFR: 22.7%). Nearly 80% were healthcare-associated infections, and no community transmission chains have developed.

VcD4f58IA2fDhMGqxppuhA.zh: 盧安達近一週新增1例病例,為先前病例之接觸者,迄今累計報告66例確診,其中15例死亡(CFR:22.7%),仍有2例治療中,559名接觸者追蹤中;病患近8成為醫療機構工作者,集中於3行政區,WHO評估傳播風險於國內極高,於區域為高,於全球則低。
VcD4f58IA2fDhMGqxppuhA.en: Rwanda reported 1 new case in the past week, a contact of a previous case. To date, 66 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, including 15 deaths (CFR: 22.7%). Two patients are still under treatment, and 559 contacts are being followed up. Nearly 80% of patients are healthcare workers, concentrated in 3 administrative districts. WHO assesses the risk of transmission as very high nationally, high regionally and low globally.

wopVowDxtnIiuLBbTRO6Hg.zh: 盧安達10/24報告新增2例病例,其中1例為醫護相關人員,另1例曾與指標個案暴露於同一採礦洞穴,目前皆於醫療機構隔離治療中。截至10/26累計報告65例確診病例,其中15例死亡(CFR:23%),47例已康復,病例主要分布於吉佳利,目前1,100餘名接觸者追蹤中。
wopVowDxtnIiuLBbTRO6Hg.en: Rwanda reported 2 new cases on 24 October: one was a health-care worker, and the other had been exposed to the index case in the same mine cave. Both are isolated and being treated in healthcare facilities. As of 26 October, 65 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, including 15 deaths (CFR: 23%) and 47 recoveries. Cases are mainly distributed in Kigali, and more than 1,100 contacts are being followed up.

djZYdgHwn5bwZ2qvhBvz8Q.zh: 盧安達近一週未新增病例,截至10/21累計報告62例確診病例,其中15例死亡(CFR:24.2%),1例隔離治療中,46例已康復。WHO 10/18表示,逾8成病患為首都吉佳利某2家醫療機構之工作者,目前仍有800餘名接觸者追蹤中。另當地研究員表示,目前所有案例之病毒基因序列均密切相關,顯示為同一事件,且未發現具威脅性之突變。
djZYdgHwn5bwZ2qvhBvz8Q.en: Rwanda has reported no new cases in the past week. As of 21 October, 62 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, including 15 deaths (CFR: 24.2%); 1 case is still in isolation and treatment, and 46 have recovered. WHO said on 18 October that more than 80% of patients were workers at two healthcare facilities in the capital, Kigali, and more than 800 contacts are still being followed up. Local researchers also said that the viral genetic sequences of all cases are closely related, indicating a single event, and no threatening mutations have been found.

kvJYwj3Ut5c5PnxmiUvQHw.zh: 盧安達近一週疫情趨緩,截至10/15累計報告62例病例,其中15例死亡(CFR:24.2%),21例隔離治療中,26例已康復。WHO 10/11表示,逾8成病患為醫療工作者,來自首都吉佳利(Kigali)某2間醫療機構,目前仍有約700名接觸者追蹤中;評估傳播風險於國內為非常高,於區域為高,於全球則低。 韓國宣布10/10起針對來自盧安達、衣索比亞、烏干達、剛果民主共和國及坦尚亞入境旅客加強檢疫措施。
kvJYwj3Ut5c5PnxmiUvQHw.en: Rwanda's outbreak has slowed over the past week. As of 15 October, 62 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 15 deaths (CFR: 24.2%); 21 patients are in isolation treatment and 26 have recovered. WHO stated on 11 October that more than 80% of patients are healthcare workers from two healthcare facilities in the capital, Kigali, and about 700 contacts are still being followed up. WHO assesses the risk of spread as very high nationally, high regionally and low globally. South Korea announced that from 10 October it will strengthen quarantine measures for arriving travellers from Rwanda, Ethiopia, Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Tanzania.
